summary: The count looks wrong: Word comes that in {county}, {chair} is telling voters how to vote and handling the ballots, and your race may turn on that count.
realLife: On primary day in 1962 a cousin warned that something was wrong in Quitman County, Georgia. A friend saw the county boss telling voters how to vote; a judge later threw out the county's ballots, and Carter won his state senate seat.
